description: Return a list of all Timecard Time Types for a specified Project.

id.description: Unique identifier of the timecard time type.

time_type.description: Display name of the time type (e.g., Regular Time, Overtime, Holiday).

abbreviated_time_type.description: Abbreviated code for this time type (e.g., REG, OVE, HOL).

global.description: Whether this is a system-provided global time type or a company-custom one.
